operator_visible_outcome: Process-supervision sources and tests are split by lifecycle ownership without changing launch, observation, cleanup or outcome behaviour

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked process-supervision source, test, build-tag, symbol and native-behaviour inventories

outputs.validation: Deterministic process-supervision split acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: The process-supervision declaration, test, build-tag and native-binding inventories are preserved across the split
Launch preparation, suspended process start, standard-stream construction and resource closure are owned by launch_windows.go, process_start_windows.go, pipes_windows.go and resources_windows.go

Observation orchestration, completion and deadline arbitration, process-tree cleanup and final outcome projection are owned by observation_windows.go, wait_windows.go, cleanup_windows.go and outcome_windows.go
Container, image, environment, wait, stream, startup-cleanup, layout and resource-close tests remain beside their declared owners
End-to-end supervisor behaviour remains in supervisor_windows_test.go while process-tree cleanup evidence is owned by process_tree_windows_test.go
derived_state: Focused launch, wait, stream, cleanup, outcome, process-tree and independent Assurance verdicts

authorities.grant: Accept only the exact declared process-supervision split files and preserved inventories
authorities.refusal: Reject an old mixed-responsibility file, missing destination, undeclared sibling, duplicate declaration or changed source or test inventory

authorities.grant: Independently compare the exact split inventories and native supervision rules
authorities.refusal: Reject changed launch, deadline, cleanup, process-tree, containment, executable-identity, stream or outcome semantics

trust_boundaries.treatment: Compare the exact process-supervision source tree, symbol, test and build-tag inventories with this manifest
Compare Production results with independent lifecycle, containment, process-tree and failure-precedence evidence

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded NUL-delimited tracked-file inventory
resources.bound: At most 100000 paths, 16777216 aggregate source bytes and 30000 milliseconds
resources.release: Release inventory and parsed syntax when policy evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an infrastructure error without accepting the tree

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded strict architecture policy document
resources.bound: At most 1048576 bytes per inventory or fixture
resources.release: Release decoded policy when independent evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an assurance error without accepting the tree

platforms.evidence: Native Production and Assurance policy and process-supervision execution

platforms.refusal: Process execution remains unavailable outside the qualified Windows AMD64 boundary
platforms.evidence: Unsupported-platform refusal and compile checks only

invariants.statement: The split preserves every process-supervision declaration, test target, build constraint and native binding
invariants.falsifier: A declaration, test target, build constraint or native binding is missing, duplicated or moved to the wrong lifecycle responsibility

assurance_controls.owner: independent supervision split inventory and declaration comparison

invariants.statement: Launch, wait, cleanup and outcome projection remain separate lifecycle authorities
invariants.boundary: Configured worker launch to terminal supervised outcome
invariants.falsifier: Deadline arbitration, cleanup errors, process-tree state or outcome dimensions are duplicated, discarded or reordered

production_controls.owner: focused launch, wait, cleanup and outcome tests

invariants.residual_uncertainty: Source ownership does not prove every concurrent deadline interleaving

invariants.statement: The split preserves AppContainer setup, Job Object limits, executable identity, stream bounds and complete process-tree cleanup
invariants.boundary: Configured executable to contained process tree and bounded standard streams
invariants.falsifier: A worker gains authority, a descendant survives return, executable identity changes, a stream exceeds its bound or cleanup loses the primary failure

production_controls.owner: native containment, hostile worker, stream, deadline and process-tree tests

assurance_controls.owner: independent containment, resource and process-tree qualification

invariants.residual_uncertainty: Native containment and cleanup remain qualified only on Windows AMD64

success_semantics: Accepted means the exact declared source split preserves symbols, tests, launch and observation ordering, deadline priority, cleanup errors, process-tree ownership, containment, executable identity, stream bounds and outcome projection
refusal_semantics: An old mixed-responsibility file, missing destination, undeclared sibling, changed inventory, duplicate implementation, wrapper or supervision regression returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release source may be replaced directly; no old file, wrapper, forwarding path, duplicate implementation or migration shim is retained
falsifiers: A declaration, test target, build constraint or native binding changes during the split
An old mixed-responsibility file remains or a destination file is missing
An undeclared sibling source or test file appears in the process-supervision package
A wrapper, duplicate state model, migration path or order dependency is introduced
Deadline priority, cleanup error retention, process-tree ownership, AppContainer setup, Job Object limits, executable identity, stream bounds or unsupported-platform refusal changes

production_controls.owner: source-policy supervision split inventory and declaration fixtures
focused launch, wait, cleanup and outcome tests
native containment, hostile worker, stream, deadline and process-tree tests

assurance_controls.owner: independent supervision split inventory and declaration comparison
independent containment, resource and process-tree qualification

residual_limitations: This structural split does not establish new process-supervision behaviour
Native containment and process-tree behaviour remain qualified only on Windows AMD64
Static structure checks require native runtime and independent Assurance evidence before semantic equivalence is accepted
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change deadline priority, select arbitration, cleanup error retention, process-tree ownership or terminal projection
Change AppContainer setup, Job Object limits, executable identity, stream bounds or unsupported-platform refusal
Create an interface, wrapper, registry, option or duplicate state model
Retain an old mixed-responsibility file, forwarding path or migration shim
Move or split another package or change admission, protocol, persistence, worker or operation behaviour
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the split inventory
